messages:
luis: Kicking off a preemptible game-day planning thread. Goal: force ~10–15% evictions across mixed GPU pools in us-west1 + europe-west3 for 30m windows, validate automated failover to reserved capacity and cold-warm nodes, measure RTO/RPO, and ensure cost delta stays reasonable. Proposed run: Tue Apr 12 14:00-16:00 UTC. Plan below.

maya: +1. Can you add clear success criteria and abort conditions? Also need a dry-run.

luis: Dry-run Friday 14:00 UTC. High-level runbook: 
- Target pools: mixed-gpu-pool-1 (A100 preempt), mixed-gpu-pool-2 (T4 preempt), edge-mixed (small regions).
- Eviction method: cloud provider simulated interrupts (controlled).
- Traffic posture: start with 5% traffic diversion, ramp to 25% for test accounts only.
- Observability: collect p50/p95/p99 latencies, 5xx rates, cost burn, prefix cache hit, model KV warmup time.

sam: Runtime callouts: 
- Pre-warm KV cache by replaying representative traces 10m before the window.
- Ensure fallback model variants are registered (quantized / lower-context) and routed.
- Add a probe that checks token generation continuity (small backpressure test).

olivia: Capacity notes: 
- Will reserve a 20% buffer on dedicated pools to absorb spikes.
- For the eviction window we'll mark a subset of reserved nodes as "drainable" to test rebalancing.
- I'll prepare instance lists and a script to simulate spot evictions:
```bash
# example (GCP)
for id in $(cat target_instances.txt); do 
  gcloud compute instances simulate-maintenance-event $id --zone=us-west1-b &
done
```
(we'll share exact commands once targets are locked)

jordan: Product concern: need to protect the top-10 paying customers. Suggest whitelisting their traffic to Dedicated or routing through a higher-tier lane for the entire window.

luis: Agreed. Plan: tag prod-critical customers and route them to reserved-reserve-1. Test traffic will only use test-customer tags.

maya: Success criteria proposal (must pass all):
- End-user p99 generation latency: < +200ms delta vs baseline.
- Error rate (5xx) increase: <= +1% absolute.
- Failover RTO: < 90s to restore equivalent throughput for test traffic.
- KV cache recovery: >80% prefix cache hit within 5m of eviction start.
- No customer-severity incidents for prod-tagged customers.
- Cost delta for window: <= +20% (we can absorb spikes for the experiment).

sam: Also add: model-quality gates — automatic regression alerts if outputs degrade on our eval prompts (we'll run a small eval suite every 5m).

olivia: Abort conditions (immediate abort if any):
- Sustained 5xx > 5% for 10m, or
- Error budget burn rate > 200% of expected, or
- p99 latency > +500ms for > 5m.
If aborted: run traffic back to healthy reserved pools, scale up dedicated fallback, and run post-abort hotfix loop.

luis: Rollback commands (ops quick reference):
```bash
# route test traffic back
infractl route set --from-tag test-game-day --to reserved-reserve-1
# disable eviction simulator
python tools/evict_sim.py --stop --target mixed-gpu-pool-1
# scale dedicated up quickly
infractl scale pool reserved-reserve-1 --gpu-count +12
```

engbot: Runbook doc created: https://docs.internal/redwood/gamedays/preemptible-mixed-pool (will post updated link with instance lists after Olivia pushes targets).

maya: Observability checklist for SRE:
- Dashboard: game-day overview (p50/p95/p99, 5xx, infra-scale events) ready.
- Tracing: distributed traces tagged with run_id.
- Alerts: temporary thresholds enabled for the window.
- Cost metric: per-minute GPU cost and token cost sampled.

luis: Metrics to capture (please ensure ETL):
- Failover latency distribution (time-to-first-successful-response per client).
- Throughput reprovision time (seconds to restore baseline qps).
- Model-op fallback counts (how often we fell back to quantized/shorter-context).
- Cache warmup timeline (prefix hit ratio per minute).
- Price-per-inference delta.

sam: Test choreography: 
1) 10m pre-warm (replay traces).
2) start eviction at T0 on 10% nodes, monitor 5m.
3) ramp to 15% at T+10m.
4) sustained window 30m.
5) stop eviction, observe 15m.

olivia: I'll produce target_instances.txt by EOD and a terraform plan snippet to show which ASGs will be affected.

jordan: Can we simulate a cross-region network hiccup too? Maybe small packet loss between us-west1 and europe-west3 to validate routing policies. Only if the team is comfortable.

maya: Keep network sim optional. If added, keep it at 1% packet loss for 5m and keep abort triggers tighter.

luis: Dry-run checklist finalized. I'll schedule the Friday dry-run and add calendar invites. Everyone who replied, please RSVP.

deploy-bot: eviction-sim scheduled: pool=mixed-gpu-pool-1 start=1832359200 duration=1800 initiator=luis (dry-run)
